Almost all of the divergence happens after 2027. Their model shows relatively little separation in 2026-2027, then the curves bend sharply into 2028-2030. So my read is that it points to 2026-2027 as buildout years and 2028-2030 as economic acceleration. Kinda gets mapped as well when you look at $AMZN / $META / $GOOGL capex, and short term FCF headwinds (but massive projected profitability post 2028) 3. NVIDIA’s 800 VDC plan includes a phased rollout that operates alongside existing AC distribution systems. The adoption level depends on each facility individually, rather than replacing an entire plant all at once. In the short term, NVIDIA’s Power Rack delivers 800V DC into the compute racks and standardizes the DC interface and backup configuration so it can fit existing AC infrastructure. Following this, a row-level Power Center manages centralized rectification and supplies a full high-density row via a busway, reducing cabling complexity in white space. Over the longer term, a hall-level DC Power Block becomes the standard power building block, supporting higher-density loads. NVIDIA will collaborate with industry partners to expand demonstration and pilot sites ahead of large-scale deployment.

posts.title: 健策（3653） 公司定位 全球封裝級散熱元件龍頭，主力產品為 heat spreader、lid、stiffener，客戶涵蓋 NVIDIA、AMD 與各大 CSP ASIC。另布局冷板、CPU socket／carrier 等新應用。 核心成長邏輯 現有 Rubin 為單件 lid。 下一代 Rubin Ultra 預期改為「stiffener＋可拆卸／一次性 lid＋螺絲」，封裝後由 ODM 拆除 lid 再裝水冷板與 TIM1.5。 AMD MI450/455 維持雙 lid＋stiffener＋鍍金，CSP ASIC（Trainium3、v8 等）stiffener 規格同步升級，形成結構性內容成長。 近季與 2026 展望 2Q26 營收已強勁成長（約 +30% QoQ），散熱產品占比升至七成以上，毛利率明顯擴張。3Q26 預期再季增約 9–37%，Rubin 出貨量放大可抵銷 ASP 正常化。全年營收年增約 48–59%，毛利率上看 44–47%。 2027–28 年動能 Rubin Ultra 預計 2Q27 起量，為最大成長引擎。加上 AMD、ASIC 升級、Intel socket／carrier 認證完成，以及 CPO 交換器機構件，看好營收與 EPS 高速成長。預估 2026–28 年 EPS CAGR 約 60–100%。 風險 AI 晶片時程延遲、Rubin Ultra 最終設計未完全定案、原料成本上漲。 競爭方面，封裝級散熱品質與交期門檻高，新進者不易切入。

À good exercise for judging prior behavior is to create a script to show forward returns based on point in time analysis. „How often did a pullback reach 0-5%, 5-10%… how long did it take historically to reach ath again? What’s the distribution curve of both?“ Another thing I like to look at is the max leverage given by platforms on an asset. If the max leverage is 3x, I’ll expect a 30-40% at some point which could provide the necessary stopouts/ stop hunts to resume the trend. This is specifically in regards to momentum trades. Look back at AI, look at certain Cryptos… anticipate with the help of data what the distribution might be able to offer you as entries. These are things I look at when I get starters and open positions I’d like to pyramid down the line. If the trend breaks I lose small, while if the trend resumes I can usually add on a reclaim and eventually a breakout. This like all things is not a winning guarantee but a way to navigate chaos to your benefit. I will add on top that you want to layer the positive aspects, meaning ideally you want it to have multiple great attributes like RS, strong reactions off emas and alike, I want the strongest trends only.

The evolution of a stop loss: Beginner: "Where can I tolerate the loss?" Intermediate: "Where is the chart invalidated?" Advanced: "How large can I trade if that is the correct stop?" The stop shouldn't fit your position. The position should fit your stop.

At first, cash feels like wasted opportunity. Then you learn cash prevents bad trades. Then you learn cash gives you buying power when better setups appear. Eventually cash stops feeling like "nothing." Sometimes having no position is what gives you the best position later.
Beginners ask whether a setup works; experienced traders ask where, when, and under what conditions it works. An edge without context can become a liability when the market environment changes.
The most dangerous winning trade is one that rewards you for breaking your rules. Profit can reinforce a mistake just as easily as a loss can expose one.
